name: ImageEditor
description: Own a session for one source, or use ImageEditorView for a host-owned collection.

props.name: actions
props.description: Host action overrides; matching ids replace or hide built-ins.

props.name: assets
props.description: Host-owned decoded assets, shared with project adapters.

props.name: backend
props.description: Force a renderer; auto chooses the available backend.

props.name: canvasLabel
props.description: Accessible picture name.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra layout class.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Width below which panes use the shared sheet-and-strip layout. Defaults to 64rem.

props.name: commands
props.description: Host-supplied command definitions; matching ids replace built-ins.

props.name: defaultWorkspace
props.description: Uncontrolled initial workspace.

props.name: filters
props.description: Filters beyond those the tools bring, in the order they apply.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ workspace: string; library: string; file: string; edit: string; view: string; help: string; history: string; presets: string; layers: string; filmstrip: string; original: string; step: string; settings: string; develop: string; geometry: string; retouch: string; effects: string; files: string; docked: string; focus: string; compare: string; before: string; after: string; shortcuts: string; commands: string; nextRegion: string; previousRegion: string; unavailable: string; pan: string; open: string; save: string; export: string; copy: string; paste: string; recover: string; recovery: string; failed: string; autosave: string; noAutosave: string; templates: string; photo: string; custom: string; engine: string; singleSlider: string; avatar: string; product: string; social: string; annotator: string; developView: string; fullSuite: string; format: string; demo: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Localised words.

props.name: layerKinds
props.description: Opt-in source providers for recipe layer kinds.

props.name: onAction
props.type: ((action: ActionRequest, next: (args?: unknown) => unknown) => unknown) | undefined
props.description: Runs for every action. Call `next` to let it go ahead, or don't to stop it.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the host cancellation action runs.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with each committed change.

props.name: onDirtyChange
props.description: Reports whether committed edits differ from the last saved state.

props.name: onError
props.description: Reports operational loading, rendering or delivery failures to the host.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Explicit export delivery. The host decides whether to download, upload or persist it.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Receive the lazy edited result and cancellable delivery context. No storage occurs without this callback.

props.name: onSelectedPictureIdChange
props.description: Reports a filmstrip choice. Host switches editor without disposing other sessions.

props.name: onWorkspaceChange
props.description: Completed layout and mode changes; the host may store this value.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: pictures
props.description: Host-managed open sessions.

props.name: presets
props.description: Optional host presets. Rendering parts must belong to the supplied tools.

props.name: recipe
props.description: An earlier edit to continue from.

props.name: selectedPictureId
props.description: Current filmstrip picture.

props.name: shortcuts
props.type: Readonly<Record<string, string | readonly string[] | null>> | undefined
props.description: Key overrides by action id (for example edit.undo or tool.crop); [] disables a binding.

props.name: slots
props.description: Replacement regions. null intentionally empties a region.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL, blob or tile source. A new source starts a new session.

props.name: stages
props.description: Opt-in source stages that replay before geometry and filters.

props.name: title
props.description: Current picture name.

props.name: tools
props.description: Only these tools, sections and layer panels appear.

props.name: workspace
props.description: Controlled workspace; nothing is persisted internally.
